purpose: Prevent frontend engineering coverage from becoming claimed scientific gain. A new version is required only after a proved, prior-art-distinct mechanism exists.
one_scientific_question: Can a legal pair-distinguishing small witness be guaranteed outside the key-anchorable fragment under the stated very narrow positive-EXISTS/key/acyclic-FK assumptions?
scope: single tree-shaped non-key existential link; base set tables, outer bag/count, equality; no NULL/SUM/HAVING/negation
candidate_status: UNPROVED; no empirical bound is a sound equivalence certificate
shared_frontend_rule: Every future verifier sees identical original SQL, complete schema and complete constraints. Freeze one independently validated supported fragment; never compare repaired candidate frontend to unmodified baseline.

strong_baselines.name: VeriEQL official bounded verifier
strong_baselines.status: NOT_RUN; current six-group dataset not semantically normalized to a common verifier dialect; current runtime contract rejects all groups
strong_baselines.role: primary executable verifier only after faithful same-contract harness validated

strong_baselines.name: Few Rows Tell Them Apart key-anchorable bounds
strong_baselines.status: SCOPE_REFERENCE; verify implementation/theorem applicability on anchored control subset; no claim to outperform outside its claimed domain

strong_baselines.name: PODS2009 bag-set/count chase equivalence
strong_baselines.status: PRIOR_ART_KILL_CONTROL; exact leaf reduction under examination
strong_baselines.role: reject mere decidability or bound-existence novelty if covered

strong_baselines.name: Polygon and SpotIt+
strong_baselines.status: SURVEYED_NOT_REPRODUCED; unresolved direct-neighbor comparisons prohibit superiority claim
strong_baselines.role: scope and performance threats, not simulated baseline scores

simple_controls: Tiny-domain exhaustive legal-instance enumeration for mechanism fixture only
Existing complete contract prepare rejection (engineering control)
Original SQL in SQLite with explicit dialect caveat (replay control)
Flat unpruned encoding on identical frontend if future sound mechanism exists
ablations: One-witness-per-outer-key seed reduction versus no reduction
Synchronized key cloning from singleton-witness seed
Future: FK/key repair removed and separate legality checker to reject illegal witnesses; do not score them as valid

engineering: query admission and complete-contract admission separately
mechanism: preservation of Q1 minus Q2 multiplicity difference
existence of finite proved bound, not sampled maximum
performance_if_unblocked: verified distinguishing witnesses over all frozen source groups
proof-equivalent decisions only where theorem applies
time-quality frontier with fixed maximum wall/CPU/RSS; no exact cost equality claim

cost_accounting: source scan time and peak RSS
all attempts including errors, unknowns, failed constraints, interruptions and retries
no GPU or model API budget; AI agent research effort not measured as local CPU
failure_denominator: Six source groups, six original pairs, twelve original SQL; repetitions/fixtures are not additional independent instances. All 24 registered replay attempts and six contract checks retained.
stop_conditions: Naive transformation erases any valid pair difference: REJECT that transformation
Counterexample to key/FK legality or theorem premise: REJECT unsound candidate
Existing chase/provenance algorithm covers mechanism: REJECT novelty in that scope
Unsupported frontend or dialect mismatch: count engineering rejection, no scientific score
No natural pair in theory domain: HOLD applicability
Resource gate fails or RSS unreadable: stop, retain NOT_RUN; do not compete with unrelated_project
No frozen novel mechanism: no solver queue and no confirmation exposure

confirmation.reserve: Four separately registered source groups, withheld from current author output; all were in old global applicability scan
confirmation.limitation: Neither pristine blind final test nor hidden verified gold; separate role alone is not OS isolation or attestation
confirmation.future_requirement: Independent registrar must choose and attest an unexposed group-disjoint final source after method lock. Reused development cannot be relabelled test.

promotion: HOLD; custom scientific proof/cost design is outside automatic paired-scalar v1
